The mPFC (8 mm sphere centered on x = −4, y = 54, z = 4) was chosen given that it typically coactivates with the PCC to smoking cues and shows decreased activation in experienced meditators [ 20 ]. In contrast, the dAI ROI, which has been used in our prior work [ 37 ] does not show decreased activation in meditators, yet has been linked to nicotine dependence.

Post-hoc analyses of the control regions indicated that the change in number of cigarettes in the MT group was also correlated with the reduction in mPFC activation ( r s = 0.35, p = 0.05), but not within the bilateral dAI ( r s = −0.08, p = 0.64).
